uncited: It addresses the memory overhead and access inefficiencies of dense voxel grids by grouping data into spatially coherent units that can be loaded, compressed, or traversed independently.

The family encompasses methods that use spatial partitioning for adaptive mesh refinement [2182-exabricks-hierarchy.md], sparse page tables for voxel datasets [2550-sparse-page-table-and-brick-pool.md], and compact encoding for segmentation labels [4985-compressed-segmentation-volume.md].

The approach has since been generalized to handle adaptive mesh refinement [2182-exabricks-hierarchy.md], sparse voxel datasets [2550-sparse-page-table-and-brick-pool.md], and semantic segmentation volumes [4985-compressed-segmentation-volume.md].
